method: Use n>=2S and n[J-RJ/A^2-R/A]>(R+B)^2/(2K), which imply paper22 sufficient criterion for every A<p<=B. Integer trial division counts primes; rational square-root brackets bound possible non-inert norm primes. Diameter bounds use pi>3 and integer square-root upper bounds.
scope: Independent exact arithmetic checks of the sufficient mixed-rank condition. Its mathematical implication of full rank is supplied by the proved sufficient-criterion lemma, not by these arithmetic checks.
